'Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu' Announces Additional Cast Pair
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Chinkururi and Nanashina's Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu: Saikyou no Bishoujo Gundan wo Tsukuriagero (Gacha Girls Corps) light novel announced a pair of additional cast on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027. Voice actresses Ai Kayano (Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!) and Rie Kugimiya (Gintama) are joining the cast as Shisuha Aibi and Luna Varad, respectively. Two New 'One Piece' Anime Movies Announced for 2027 and 2029
The second day of the "One Piece Day '26" event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba announced on Sunday that Eiichiro Oda's One Piece manga is receiving two new anime movies. The first film, titled One Piece Film God Valley, is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in Summer 2027, while the second film, One Piece Film Baad is set to release in 2029. 'Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga' Announces Additional Cast
The official X account for the television anime adaptation of Satsuki Nakamura's Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den (Though I Am an Inept Villainess) light novel announced three additional cast members on Sunday. The anime series premiered on July 12 at 11:45 p.m. on TV Tokyo, TV Osaka, TV Aichi, and other stations. 'Umayuru Full Gate!' Short Anime Announced for September 2026
The official website for the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby franchise announced a new short anime, titled Umayuru Full Gate!, on Saturday. The short anime, produced by AtoriE, will premiere in September 2026 on the official Uma Musume YouTube Channel PakaTube!. Uma Musume: Pretty Derby originally aired in 13 episodes from production studio P.A. Works in Spring 2018. The fourth and final Blu-ray volume bundled three special episodes in December that year.
